title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘further calls on the Commission to present, without further delay, legislative proposals providing for clearly visible health-related information on all alcoholic beverages, complemented by digital labelling;’
part_context: Calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that EU public health policies and alcohol-related harm prevention strategies, including but not limited to education and communication campaigns, are aligned with scientifically established health recommendations; <del>further calls on the Commission to present, without further delay, legislative proposals providing for clearly visible health-related information on all alcoholic beverages, complemented by digital labelling;</del> stresses that such measures should pay particular attention to the protection of minors, young people and other vulnerable groups;
